paragraphs: Micron Technology, Inc. is an American multinational semiconductor company that manufactures computer memory and computer data storage products, including dynamic random-access memory (DRAM), flash memory, High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), and solid-state drives (SSDs). Founded in 1978 in Boise, Idaho, Micron is the only major American computer memory manufacturer. It is one of the "Big Three" computer memory manufacturers, along with the South Korean companies Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

Micron marketed its consumer products under the brand Crucial, with the sub-brand Ballistix being used to denote products targeting gaming computers, until its disestablishment in 2026. Micron and Intel together created IM Flash Technologies, which produced NAND flash memory. It owned Lexar between 2006 and 2017.
Sanjay Mehrotra has served as president and CEO of Micron since 2017.
On May 26, 2026, Micron became the latest U.S. company to reach a US$1 trillion market capitalization, amid surging demand for its HBM chips.

people.name: Scott R. Allen
people.title: Corporate Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer
people.bio: Allen joined Micron in September 2020 and became Corporate Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer in October 2020. Previously, he held executive roles at NetApp, including Senior Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer.
people.quote: Mr. Allen was named Corporate Vice President and Chief Accounting Officer in October 2020.

people.name: April S. Arnzen
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer
people.bio: Arnzen joined Micron in December 1996 and has served in various leadership positions. She became Chief People Officer in October 2020 and Executive Vice President in October 2023.
people.quote: Ms. Arnzen, 55, joined us in December 1996 and has served in various leadership positions since that time.

people.name: Manish Bhatia
people.title: President and Chief Operating Officer
people.bio: Bhatia joined Micron as Executive Vice President, Global Operations in October 2017 and became President and Chief Operating Officer in August 2026. Previously, he held executive operations roles at Western Digital and SanDisk.
people.quote: Mr. Bhatia, 54, joined us in October 2017 as our Executive Vice President, Global Operations.

people.name: Michael D. Cordano
people.title: Executive Vice President, Worldwide Sales
people.bio: Cordano joined Micron as Executive Vice President, Worldwide Sales in January 2025. Previously, he served as Partner at Prime Impact Capital, Co-Chief Executive Officer of Prime Impact Acquisition I, and President and Chief Operating Officer of Western Digital.
people.quote: Mr. Cordano, 62, joined us in January 2025 as our Executive Vice President, Worldwide Sales.

people.name: Scott J. DeBoer
people.title: President and Chief Technology and Products Officer
people.bio: DeBoer joined Micron in February 1995 and has served in various leadership positions. He became President and Chief Technology and Products Officer in August 2026.
people.quote: Dr. DeBoer, 60, joined us in February 1995 and has served in various leadership positions since that time.

people.name: Sanjay Mehrotra
people.title: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Mehrotra joined Micron as President, Chief Executive Officer, and Director in May 2017 and became Chairman in January 2025. He co-founded SanDisk in 1988 and served as its President and Chief Executive Officer from January 2011 to May 2016.
people.quote: Mr. Mehrotra has served as Chairman of our Board of Directors since January 2025.

people.name: Mark J. Murphy
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Murphy joined Micron as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer in April 2022. Previously, he served as Chief Financial Officer of Qorvo and Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Delphi Automotive.
people.quote: Mr. Murphy, 59, joined us in April 2022 as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.

people.name: Michael Ray
people.title: Senior Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Ray joined Micron as Senior Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary in January 2024. Previously, he served as Chief Legal Officer of Western Digital.
people.quote: Mr. Ray, 59, joined us in January 2024 as our Senior Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary.

people.name: Sumit Sadana
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Business Officer
people.bio: The 2025 named executive officer discussion identifies Sadana as Executive Vice President and Chief Business Officer, responsible for the Company's P&L and business units; he is not listed in the October 2026 executive officer section. He has served on Silicon Labs' board since 2015 and became its lead independent director in 2022.
people.quote: Mr. Sadana, our Executive Vice President and Chief Business Officer, has more than 30 years of experience in the technology industry.

people.name: Lynn A. Dugle
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Served as Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, and President of Engility Holdings from March 2016 to January 2019. Previously served as Corporate Vice President and President of Intelligence and Information Systems at Raytheon.
people.quote: the Board unanimously elected Lynn Dugle as our Lead Independent Director.

people.name: Steven J. Gomo
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as NetApp's Executive Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer from October 2004 until December 2011, following service as Senior Vice President, Finance and Chief Financial Officer.
people.quote: Mr. Gomo's experience as the chief financial officer of a public technology company provides our Board expertise in the technology industry

people.name: Linnie M. Haynesworth
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as Sector Vice President of Northrop Grumman's Cyber and Intelligence Mission Solutions Division from January 2016 to 2019 and as Sector Vice President and General Manager from December 2013 to 2019.
people.quote: Ms. Haynesworth was a Member of the Defense Business Board of the United States Department of Defense from November 2021 to April 2025.

people.name: T. Mark Liu
people.title: Director
people.bio: Founder and Chairman of J&M Copper Beech Ventures since April 2024. Served as Executive Chairman of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited from June 2018 to June 2024.
people.quote: Mr. Liu's experience holding operations leadership positions, including Executive Chairman, in Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited

people.name: Sanjay Mehrotra
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Has served as Micron's President, Chief Executive Officer, and Director since May 2017 and Chairman since January 2025. Co-founded SanDisk in 1988 and served as its President and Chief Executive Officer from January 2011 to May 2016.
people.quote: Mr. Mehrotra has served as Micron's President, Chief Executive Officer, and Director since May 2017 and has served as Micron's Chairman since January 2025.

people.name: A. Christine Simons
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as a partner at Deloitte & Touche LLP from August 2004 to May 2025, including leadership of its Global Semiconductor Center of Excellence and U.S. Technology, Media & Telecommunications Audit & Assurance practice.
people.quote: We believe these experiences, qualifications, attributes, and skills qualify Ms. Simons to serve as a member of our Board.

people.name: Robert H. Swan
people.title: Director
people.bio: Has served as an Operating Partner at Andreessen Horowitz since July 2021. Previously served as Intel's Chief Executive Officer from February 2019 to February 2021, following roles as interim Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer.
people.quote: Mr. Swan served at Intel Corporation, a semiconductor manufacturing company, as Chief Executive Officer from February 2019 to February 2021

people.name: MaryAnn Wright
people.title: Director
people.bio: Served as Group Vice President of Engineering and Product Development at Johnson Controls International from 2013 to 2017. Previously held executive roles at Johnson Controls, Johnson Controls-Saft, Collins & Aikman, and Ford Motor Company.
people.quote: Within the past five years, Ms. Wright served on the Board of Directors of Maxim Integrated Products, Inc.

people.name: Richard M. Beyer
people.title: Director (retiring at the Annual Meeting)
people.bio: Served as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Freescale Semiconductor from 2008 through June 2012 and as a director from 2008 to 2013. Previously served as President, Chief Executive Officer, and director of Intersil from 2002 to 2008.
people.quote: Mr. Beyer and Ms. McCarthy will continue to serve as directors through the end of their terms at the Annual Meeting.

people.name: Mary Pat McCarthy
people.title: Director (retiring at the Annual Meeting)
people.bio: Served as Vice Chair of KPMG LLP from July 1998 until her retirement in December 2011. Joined KPMG in 1977 and became a partner in 1987.
people.quote: Ms. McCarthy has served as Chair of the Audit Committee since January 2023
